segments.speaker: Rep
segments.text: Hi Dana, thanks for making time. I wanted to walk through the quote for the calibration management rollout and make sure the seat counts and dates are still right.

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: Yeah, that works. We reviewed it internally yesterday. The 24 technician seats and 6 manager seats are correct for phase one.

segments.speaker: Rep
segments.text: Great. And the two lab locations are still Dayton and Fort Wayne, with Dayton going first?

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: Correct. Dayton on March 18, Fort Wayne about four weeks later. We do not need the mobile add-on for Fort Wayne yet.

segments.speaker: Rep
segments.text: Got it. The proposal has the base subscription at $38,400 annually, implementation services at $9,750, and the one-time data import at $3,200. Any concerns there?

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: No, those numbers match what we expected. Finance just asked if the annual subscription can be invoiced on April 1 instead of at signature.

segments.speaker: Rep
segments.text: Yeah, we can do that. The services invoice would still go out at signature, and the subscription invoice would be dated April 1 with net 30 terms.

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: That should be fine. Legal had one small question on the renewal language, but they said the standard 60-day notice period is acceptable.

segments.speaker: Rep
segments.text: Okay, good. I’ll send the updated order form with the April 1 billing date and the 24 plus 6 seat split. If you sign by Friday, we can keep the March 4 kickoff.

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: Friday is realistic. Send it over to me and copy our procurement inbox. I’ll route it for signature.

segments.speaker: Rep
segments.text: Will do. Anything else you want covered before I send it?
